defects: Tax overcharge: supplier billed $744.00 tax (12%) on a net of $6,200.00 where the vendor rate is 7.5% ($465.00), a $279.00 discrepancy (clause 5).
rationale: Price, quantity and receipt all match exactly (clauses 3-4, GR-7710 confirms 200 EACH). The only defect is tax: recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate the tax is $465.00, not the $744.00 billed, so the supplier overcharged by $279.00 — clause 5 requires SHORT_PAY of the corrected total $6,665.00. Single defect, so no escalation under clause 11; no credit memos to net (clause 9); $6,665.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
